title: ComicRack plugin.json manifest
description: Optional companion to Package.ini. Declares SPA UI entry points and Host API version. Package.ini Name/Version remain authoritative for install until a later dual-host cutover.

id.description: Stable plugin id; used as ConfigScript Key when auto-wiring Configure UI.

version.description: Semver-ish package version (should match Package.ini Version).

apiVersion.description: Host API major version required (1 = this contract).

kind.description: python = IronPython logic + optional SPA UI; web = SPA-first (Phase 2).

configure.description: Package-relative path to Configure SPA entry HTML (e.g. ui/dist/index.html).

hotReload.description: Watch configure entry directory and reload WebView2 on change.
